fact: Burundi's Immigration Authority announced a website on 4 October 2022 through which passports, laissez-passer and visas are now requested online.
The Burundi Revenue Office (OBR) communiqué says land tax declaration for 2026/2027 must be made online on the UMUTANGAKORI II platform by 30 September 2026.

Burundi Eco reports that OBUHA director-general Leonidas Nibigira announced building-permit applications are taken online from 6 May 2024 through the World Bank-financed Building Permit System, with applications tracked by a system number and SMS or e-mail notice.
